translations.web: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
translations.bsb: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
translations.kjv: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
translations.asv: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp: Sing praises unto him with the psaltery of ten strings.
